name: Command

released.note: Released as a beta under the API id command-xlarge-20221108; renamed command on 2023-04-26.

deprecated.note: Deprecated for new customers; existing users keep access until a shutdown date, which Cohere had not set as of 2026-10-01. The changelog announcement page is dated 2025-09-16.

milestones.label: API id command-xlarge renamed to command

summary.text: Command is the first model in Cohere's Command line: a text-only language model released in beta on 8 November 2022, which Cohere conditioned to respond well to single-statement commands. It was offered on the Cohere API, Amazon Bedrock and Oracle OCI with a 4k-token context, received weekly nightly builds from January 2023 and was deprecated on 15 September 2025.

sources.locator: Using Command Models on Different Platforms

access.note: Amazon Bedrock id cohere.command-text-v14 and Oracle OCI id cohere.command v15.6 per the platform table.

notes: First Command model; earlier unnamed size tiers of the Generate endpoint are out of scope, so no predecessor is recorded. Nightly builds (command-xlarge-nightly, later command-nightly) are aliases of this record, as are the same-name updates announced in the docs release notes titled June 28th 2023, August 8th 2023 and September 29th 2023 (the last also covered command-light). command-xlarge-20221108 was redirected to command-xlarge-nightly from 2023-01-17 and discontinued after 2023-01-30 (src.cohere.changelog-command-nightly). Renamed from command-xlarge to command on 2023-04-26 (src.cohere.changelog-model-names). The deprecation notice recommends command-r-08-2024, command-r-plus-08-2024 or command-a-03-2025 as replacements without pairing them, so replacedBy is left out. Context 4k comes from the current docs page; the 2022 changelog gives no context size. Cohere does not disclose the parameter count.
